bagPolicy.summary: The Luke Combs concert guidance allowed clear bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, one-gallon clear zip bags and clutches up to 4.5 × 6.5 inches. Medical equipment was subject to extra screening; all bags were inspected.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The university’s Luke Combs concert page advises buying a parking pass before arrival and provides a shuttle map from the concert lots. Individual lots and prices are event-specific.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: For football games, rideshare drop-off points before the game are Compton Family Ice Arena, the Rugby Lot (off Wilson Drive), and the Lake Lot (on Dorr Road). After the game, pickup points are the Dorr Road parking lot, the Ivy Road and Bulla Road area, and Vaness Street. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

concessions.summary: Notre Dame Stadium is cashless, according to its Luke Combs concert page. The venue’s guide says stadium concessions accept cards and mobile payment, and outside food and drinks are prohibited.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The Luke Combs concert page permits medical bags and equipment after additional screening and pumps for nursing mothers. The stadium football guide lists upper-level elevators near Sections 10/11 and 29/30.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: For football games, re-entry is not allowed; if you leave, you need a new, unused ticket to get back in. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

ticketPickup.summary: For Notre Dame football games, ticket resolution booths at Gates B and D open three hours before kickoff. The Murnane Family Ticket Office is at 574-631-7356, Monday through Friday, 9 am to 4 pm ET. Concerts can differ, so check your event page.

gates.summary: The Luke Combs concert page states that bags are inspected on entry but does not provide a universal stadium concert gate-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
